verdict.rationale: Mercury ships an official, documented MCP server (mcp.mercury.com/mcp) with connection instructions, supported tools (balance queries, transaction graphs, natural-language Q&A), and security controls like access revocation, corroborated by a probe confirming the docs page exists. This is a SaaS/banking platform, not itself an agent, so the axis applies and is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: independent third-party/hands-on confirmation of a live agent successfully connecting via the MCP server beyond vendor docs.
